explication: Bitwarden Android is a password-manager app. Its visible product surface includes account authentication, Android autofill (including accessibility-based autofill), browser integration, and premium billing. The principal user-to-result workflow represented here is an Android autofill request being processed into a fill response. The tree identifies the relevant components, but most implementation excerpts are absent, so internal links are limited to relationships made explicit by the sampled source or component contracts.
